title: Sealed Dungeon card: the game's marker
caption: At Lv 12 the Sealed Dungeon card shows the game's map marker on a dark tile, and the purple Kibelisk crest before the nearest Kibelisk.

title: Stronghold card: the game's marker
caption: The Stronghold card now shows the game's campfire marker on a dark tile instead of a castle on red.

title: Dungeons card markers and feathers
caption: Both headings carry their map marker, and each region shows its Empyrean Trace count with a feather, so long region names stay on one line.
